mapper.select: SELECT pb.pb_id AS processBatchId, fb.batch_id AS fishBatchId, ni.name AS processNodeName, pb.process_date AS applyTime, pb.state AS applyState FROM process_batch pb LEFT JOIN fish_batch fb ON pb.source_batch_id = fb.fb_id AND pb.source_node_type = 1 LEFT JOIN node_info ni ON pb.node_id = ni.node_id WHERE fb.node_id = #{nodeId}
